sources.title: Smart GPUGate malware exploits GitHub and Google Ads for evasive ...
sources.snippet: Dubbed GPUGate, the campaign uses malicious GitHub Desktop installers to distribute its payload masquerading as legitimate software. Attackers are using trusted platforms to bypass traditional detection methods and lure users into downloading the malware.
